links.outcome: Radiologist diagnostic AUC with versus without AI aid
links.effect: BreNet-aided scheme increased the pooled AUC of the radiologists from 0.841 to 0.934 for reviewing images, and from 0.892 to 0.934 in the real-world test.
links.quote: BreNet-aided scheme increased the pooled AUC of the radiologists from 0.841 to 0.934 for reviewing images, and from 0.892 to 0.934 in the real-world test.

links.outcome: AI diagnostic performance compared with six radiologists on same data
links.quote: The diagnostic performance of BreNet was superior to that of the radiologists (area under the curve [AUC]: 0.996 vs. 0.841).

screen.reason: The study evaluates a multi-modal deep-learning model (BreNet) for breast cancer diagnosis and tests a BreNet-aided radiologist workflow, comparing radiologist performance with vs without AI assistance.
